_doc: Features painted into original facade textures, in the texture's own pixels (x right, y down from the top-left of build/textures/<grd>.png). tools/blender/build_zone_art.py rebuilds them as geometry wherever a wall uses the texture: openings are cut and recessed (glass/door panel at the back keeps the painted image), frame_px wide surrounds and bands stand proud of the wall, crenels become solid merlons. Check alignment with: python tools/environment/facades.py. Sizes in metres; 'trim' names the texture used for reveals and the stone faces the painting doesn't cover.
